title: My game won't save! How do I fix it?

posts.author: skatefilter5
posts.body:
Whatever I save the game, the error message pop-ups it does autosaves sometimes depend how many parallel events are running especially comment events.
I'm make a platforming game that requires a lot of parallel events without any performance drops.

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: Did the path where your game is allows to write files? Game is on local drive?

posts.author: skatefilter5
posts.body:
fizzly said:
Did the path where your game is allows to write files? Game is on local drive?
Click to expand...
Yes. I usually store my projects in C:/Folder just incase I don't lose it
After setting up my scripts for jump and movement my PC froze after I finish testing it and I have to restart my PC and now project is now corrupted but all everything but the game.exe are okay. So I have to transfer all my stuff that isn't corrupt into the new project. The save works ok in the custom main menu after I boot up. But when started all parallel events start processing then I can't save.

posts.author: SeaPhoenix
posts.body: Are you using any plugins that modify how games are saved? Since you mentioned that the game autosaves, does the error message pop up during a regular save (going to the menu, and then going to "Save"), during autosave, or both?

posts.author: skatefilter5
posts.body: visastella save core I only use. I also tested without this plugin and it still won't let me save.

posts.author: skatefilter5
posts.body:
SeaPhoenix said:
Are you using any plugins that modify how games are saved? Since you mentioned that the game autosaves, does the error message pop up during a regular save (going to the menu, and then going to "Save"), during autosave, or both?
Click to expand...
Okay i found a way to save my map by turning off these switches for common events that runs platformin then switch to a blank map and save and IT WORKED! The only thing I can't save was in the main menu.
ParallRun =ON ------- These switches causes to not save due to multi parallel-common events
◆Control Variables：#0861 PlayerSaveGame X = Map X of Player
◆Control Variables：#0862 PlayerSaveGame Y = Map Y of Player
◆Control Variables：#0863 MAP SaveGame ID = Map ID
◆Control Switches：#0020 ParallRun = OFF
◆Control Switches：#0001 Run Whatever..... = OFF
◆Control Switches：#0200 Temp. Run = OFF   -
◆Transfer Player：Save Game Screen (7,6)
◆Change Transparency：ON
◆Script：$gameScreen.clearPictures()
◆Wait：1 frame
◆Open Save Screen
◆Wait：1 frame
◆Transfer Player：{MAP SaveGame ID} ({PlayerSaveGame X},{PlayerSaveGame Y})
◆Change Transparency：OFF
◆Control Switches：#0020 ParallRun = ON
◆Control Switches：#0001 Run Whatever..... = ON
◆Control Switches：#0200 Temp. Run = ON
◆Control Switches：#0300 Set Save Point = OFF
◆Control Switches：#0299 Set Save Point Warp = OFF
I guess I solve it myself then.
CHEERS!
